test_cases.test_name: Filter records to retain only those where the account status is 'ACTIVE'.

generation_notes: Generated scenarios cover active and inactive account statuses, null handling for account status, and boundary conditions for account balance.

scenarios.description: A scenario where the account is active and has a valid balance.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The record should be retained and loaded into the target as the account status is 'ACTIVE'.
scenarios.title: Active Account with Valid Balance

scenarios.description: A scenario where the account is inactive and should be filtered out.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The record should be filtered out and not loaded into the target as the account status is not 'ACTIVE'.
scenarios.title: Inactive Account

scenarios.description: A scenario where the account status is null.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The record should be filtered out and not loaded into the target due to null account status.
scenarios.title: Null Account Status

scenarios.description: A scenario where the account is active but has a zero balance.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The record should be retained and loaded into the target as the account status is 'ACTIVE', despite having a zero balance.
scenarios.title: Zero Balance Active Account

scenarios.description: A scenario where the account is active and has the maximum possible balance within precision.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The record should be retained and loaded into the target as the account status is 'ACTIVE' and balance is within the allowed precision.
scenarios.title: Active Account with Maximum Balance
